name: Construct
description: A Minecraft Bedrock addon to ease the survival building process.

releases.name: v1.1.0 for MC 26.30
releases.notes:
### __What's New__
- __**Minecraft 26.30 Support**__
- Command Interface: All functionality available through the graphical menu is now also available using vanilla commands.
- Construct API: Construct's instances and builder settings can be managed through a brand-new API so you can control Construct programmatically. Documentation is available on GitHub.
### __Fixes__
- Included a potential fix for a manifest issue that prevented Construct from working on Realms.

releases.name: v1.0.9 for MC 26.20
releases.notes:
### __What's New__
- __**Minecraft 26.20 Support**__
### __Improvements__
- `.mcstructure` files in the `structures` folder will now be populated in the structure list, so you don't have to type the file name.

releases.name: v1.0.7 for MC 26.0
releases.notes:
### __What's New__
- __**Minecraft 26.0 Support**__
- Chinese language translation, thanks to [wed150](https://github.com/wed150) & [EndrTrekker](https://github.com/EndrTrekker)!
### __Improvements__
- `/item` -> `/construct`
- Construct is no longer dependent on **Canopy**, and the `./construct` command has been removed.
- Moved the "How to Add/Remove Structures" button to the top-level menu.
- Structure info tip now uses translatable block names instead of identifiers.
### __Fixes__
- Items grabbed via the Material Grabber no longer lose their NBT data.
- EasyPlacing powder snow no longer destroys the bucket as well.
- Fixed an issue on servers where the player could get stick in flexible movement mode after relogging.

releases.name: v1.0.6 for MC 1.21.130
releases.notes:
### __What's New__
- __**Minecraft 1.21.130 Support**__
- __Translation__! If you'd like to translate Construct, don't hesitate to open a Pull Request on GitHub or get in touch on Discord.
### __Improvements__
- `fastEasyPlace` now requires the player to "use" the item to build.
### __Fixes__
- Waterlogged bubble columns can now be easyplaced.
- Comparators and repeaters are now always easyplaced as unpowered.
- `materialGrabber` will no longer grab shulkers, deleting their contents in the process.

releases.name: v1.0.4 for MC 1.21.111
releases.notes:
### __What's new__
- **__Minecraft 1.21.111 Support__**
- Flexible Move allows easy, precise structure movement using the movement keys.
### __Improvements__
- `/item` - No longer requires cheats and is now accessible in hardcore mode.

releases.name: v1.0.2 for MC 1.21.90
releases.notes:
### __What's new__
- Waterlogged block state will now show up in the structure block states tooltip.
- Incorrectly waterlogged/non-waterlogged blocks will now show up as incorrect states in block validation.
### __Improvements__
- EasyPlace will now pull from the smallest stack in your inventory instead of the first one it finds.
- FastEasyPlace will no longer place blocks inside the player.
- FastEasyPlace can now place 2x faster than before.
### __Fixes__
- Fixed most missing block placement sounds. Please open a bug report for any that are still missing.
- Fixed MaterialGrabber selecting items from a deleted structure instance.
- Builder options now check the offhand slot before adding their associated item.

releases.name: v1.0.1 for MC 1.21.90
releases.notes:
### __What's new__
- **Minecraft 1.21.90 Support**
### __Improvements__
- Fixed a bug where disabled instances would become re-enabled when rejoining a server.
- Easy Place now includes block placement sounds.
